El rol estará enfocado en construir y mantener soluciones fullstack AWS, utilizando tecnologías como Python, TypeScript, C# o JavaScript, bases de datos SQL/NoSQL, CI/CD y arquitecturas modernas como microservicios o serverless.
attributes.functions:

  • Desarrollar y mantener soluciones de software Fullstack, utilizando lenguajes y frameworks definidos para cada proyecto.
  • Diseñar, construir y mantener APIs, servicios y componentes integrados con arquitecturas cloud.
  • Desarrollar soluciones sobre AWS, utilizando servicios como Lambda, S3, EC2, API Gateway, RDS, DynamoDB u otros según las necesidades del proyecto.
  • Participar en el desarrollo de soluciones basadas en microservicios, arquitecturas serverless y componentes distribuidos.
  • Diseñar e implementar integraciones con bases de datos SQL y NoSQL, incluyendo modelado, consultas y manejo de información.

  • Aplicar buenas prácticas de desarrollo, incluyendo testing, code review, documentación y estándares de código.
  • Resolver problemas técnicos e incidentes relacionados con aplicaciones y servicios en ambientes productivos.

attributes.title: Back-end Senior Java – Apigee y GCP
attributes.description:
Mínimo 5 años de experiencia comprobable en desarrollo backend con Java y Spring Boot en arquitecturas de microservicios. Experiencia práctica diseñando, configurando y desplegando API Proxies en Google Apigee (Apigee X o Hybrid) para integración interna y exposición externa. Experiencia sólida integrando microservicios con Google Cloud Storage para carga, descarga, streaming y gestión segura de archivos. Experiencia con el ecosistema GCP: Cloud SQL, Cloud Pub/Sub y Secret Manager. Experiencia instrumentando observabilidad distribuida con Elastic APM. Capacidad demostrable para trabajar en entregas incrementales (vertical slicing): dividir soluciones complejas en iteraciones cortas y funcionales.

Requisitos técnicos (hands-on)

Java 25: manejo de características modernas del lenguaje, como Virtual Threads, Pattern Matching y Structured Concurrency.

Spring Boot 3+: Spring Data JPA, Spring Security y Spring Cloud GCP.

Apigee:
Construcción y mantenimiento de API Proxies internos y externos. Políticas de seguridad: OAuth 2.0, JWT, API Keys y mTLS. Control de tráfico: Spike Arrest, Quota y Rate Limiting. Mediación y transformación de datos (JSON/XML) y manejo estandarizado de errores (FaultRules). Configuración de Target Servers y Service Callouts.

Google Cloud Storage: uso del SDK oficial de Java para transferencias eficientes (multipart y streaming), metadatos, permisos IAM y generación de Signed URLs.

Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL): modelado relacional, configuración de pools de conexión (HikariCP) y optimización de consultas.

Cloud Pub/Sub: flujos de eventos asíncronos con publicación y suscripción desacopladas.

GCP Core: despliegue en GKE y gestión de variables y claves en Secret Manager.

Diseño de APIs: contratos bajo OpenAPI 3.1 / Swagger y diseño guiado por especificaciones (Spec-Driven Development), definiendo y validando los contratos antes de implementar.

Observabilidad: instrumentación con agente Java de Elastic APM u OpenTelemetry para trazar transacciones entre Apigee, el backend y servicios externos; monitoreo de latencia y errores en Kibana.

Testing: JUnit 5, Mockito y Testcontainers (con PostgreSQL y emuladores de GCP).

Criterio para priorizar excepciones, deuda técnica y capacidad del equipo, y vocación para formar equipos.

Contamos con el portafolio de bebidas más grande de la región y partnerships con líderes globales como PepsiCo y AB InBev. En los últimos años nos hemos expandido globalmente y reorganizado en cuatro unidades de negocio: apex (transformación), cbc (distribución), beliv (innovación en bebidas) y bia (alimentos).

En este rol serás responsable del marco de arquitectura de Apex Digital: gobernarás el diseño empresarial, de soluciones, de datos e IA, de integración y de procesos para que SAP y las plataformas digitales operen como un solo sistema. Liderarás a los equipos de arquitectos y especialistas de procesos y reportarás al Digital Technology Director.

You will work alongside experienced engineers on backend services, data pipelines, APIs, and cloud-based systems that process large volumes of retail data. You will have the opportunity to develop practical experience with technologies including cloud platforms, analytics databases, data orchestration tools, and AI-enabled development workflows.

We value curiosity, ownership, a willingness to learn quickly, and the ability to solve problems collaboratively. You do not need to have experience with every technology in our stack, but you should have strong technical fundamentals and be motivated to grow into a highly capable backend engineer.

Krunchbox is a retail analytics platform used by global consumer brands to transform point-of-sale data into actionable insights. Our platform ingests and processes large volumes of retail data from retailers across North America and Australia, helping brands understand sales performance, optimize inventory, and make smarter supply chain decisions.

We are modernizing our platform architecture and rebuilding core components with a focus on scalability, performance, and AI-driven insights. The Junior Backend Engineer will work alongside experienced engineers to help build the next generation of our data platform, contributing to backend services, APIs, data ingestion pipelines, and cloud infrastructure.

  • Use modern AI-assisted development tools to accelerate learning, coding, debugging, and problem-solving.

attributes.title: Ingeniero Full-Stack Laravel/Vue
attributes.description:
Requisitos:

• 5 años o más de experiencia profesional con PHP, idealmente Laravel.

• Capacidad real de leer, entender y mantener código existente con años de historia, no solo arrancar proyectos desde cero.

• MySQL a escala: has trabajado con tablas de millones de registros y sabes de índices y paginación eficiente.

• Vue.js sólido para trabajo full-stack.

• Diseño y consumo de APIs REST que escalan.

• Ownership: tomas un producto y lo llevas a producción. Detectas tus errores antes de entregar.

• Git con flujo profesional: manejo de branches, pull requests y participación activa en code reviews.

• Entorno de desarrollo Linux: configuración autónoma de stack local en Ubuntu (Apache, PHP, MySQL) sin dependencia de soporte externo.

Sobre el uso de IA

Usamos IA todos los días y esperamos que tú también. La regla es simple: la IA amplifica tu criterio, no lo sustituye. Debes entender cada línea que mandas a producción. Durante el proceso vas a defender tu código en vivo, sin asistentes: explicar tus decisiones, encontrar errores en código ajeno y modificar comportamiento en tiempo real.

Soft skills (competencias clave que valoramos):

• Criterio técnico en revisión de código. Capacidad para identificar vulnerabilidades, cuellos de botella y errores de lógica, tanto en código propio como en el generado por IA.

• Ownership del resultado. Asumir plena responsabilidad sobre el código entregado. La IA es una herramienta; las decisiones y sus consecuencias son del desarrollador.

• Autonomía operativa. Capacidad para tomar un proyecto, definir el camino y ejecutarlo de principio a fin. Esperamos consultas estratégicas, no acompañamiento constante.

• Documentación de decisiones. Más allá del código, registrar el razonamiento detrás de las decisiones de arquitectura: el "por qué" que da contexto a futuras iteraciones del equipo.
attributes.projects:
El proyecto

El equipo construirá un producto nuevo completo: backend en Laravel, frontend en Vue, flujo de referidos e integración de pagos con Stripe, desde la spec hasta producción. Al lanzarlo, sigue el próximo producto del plan. Aquí no se mantiene lo de otros: se construye lo propio.

Sobre nosotros

PoderJudicialVirtual es una empresa legaltech mexicana con más de 10 años en el mercado. Operamos la plataforma de datos judiciales más grande de México: más de 65 millones de registros de todo el país, con despachos, empresas y miles de personas usando y pagando el servicio todos los días. Somos rentables y no dependemos de inversionistas para ejecutar nuestro plan.
attributes.functions:
Buscamos al ingeniero que se sumará al equipo que va a construir el próximo producto de PoderJudicialVirtual de punta a punta y llevarlo a producción. Es un rol de constructor dentro de un equipo de desarrollo: entre todos toman la especificación, diseñan el backend en Laravel, construyen el frontend en Vue, integran los pagos con Stripe y lo lanzan a miles de usuarios reales. Con ownership real de tu parte del producto, sin capas intermedias y sin nadie revisándote el hombro.

No es un asiento más en una fábrica de software. Estamos ejecutando nuestro plan 2030: pasar de 2 productos en producción a 11 y expandirnos a Sudamérica. Tú construyes el primero de esa nueva ola, y quien construye bien aquí se convierte en pieza central de todo lo que sigue. El crecimiento se gana construyendo, no por antigüedad.

Te integrarás a un equipo de desarrollo en México, de la mano de un líder técnico fuerte, dueño de la arquitectura y la infraestructura, y de un Product Manager Senior que te entrega specs claras con Definition of Ready y Definition of Done. Tú eres dueño del código: de que escale, de que cobre bien y de que llegue a producción sin sorpresas.

Vas a trabajar sobre un dominio complejo (la infraestructura judicial mexicana) que tarda meses en dominarse. No esperamos que llegues sabiéndolo. Sí esperamos que en pocos meses tomes decisiones técnicas independientes y que tu código hable por ti.

attributes.projects:
Somos Capitaria, basamos nuestra estrategia de crecimiento en la convicción de que los mercados financieros latinoamericanos tienen un gran potencial de desarrollo.

Somos una empresa con gran desarrollo tecnológico, que se destaca por su juventud, innovación y que ha sido reconocida por el Great Place to Work como la mejor compañía para trabajar en Chile y Latinoamérica.

Formarás parte de un equipo multidisciplinario de alto rendimiento, donde buscamos día a día sacar lo mejor de cada uno para crecer profesional y personalmente.

“Customer centricity” define todo lo que hacemos. Todo lo que creamos debe estar pensado para que sea simple para nuestros usuarios y que motiven a la acción y conversión dependiendo el objetivo de cada contenido.

Nos apasionan los datos, somos una empresa y un equipo “data driven”. No hacemos cosas “lindas”, hacemos cosas que funcionen, y para lograrlo, es fundamental mantener una metodología experimental para ir aprendiendo en el proceso.
attributes.functions:
Diseñar, construir y llevar a producción soluciones de datos, agentes de IA y automatización que permitan a Capitaria conocer mejor a sus clientes y acompañarlos en cada etapa de su ciclo de vida. El cargo parte de prototipos simples, mide sus resultados y hace crecer las soluciones que demuestran valor, contribuyendo a mejores decisiones comerciales bajo los lineamientos definidos por la estrategia.

  • Datos del clente
    Construir y mantener pipelines y modelos de datos que integren a las distintas fuentes de la compañía (CRM propio, plataforma de trading, WhatsApp, llamadas, web y campañas) en una visión única de cada cliente.
  • Instrumentación y calidad de datos
    Diseñar, junto a Marketing y a las áreas de negocio, el tracking de eventos que asegure datos completos, consistentes y confiables.
  • Modelos y motores de decisión
    Llevar a producción modelos de scoring, recomendación y reglas de negocio automatizadas, incorporando desde el diseño límites de contacto que cuiden la experiencia del cliente.
  • Agentes de IA y automatizaciones
    Construir y operar agentes basados en modelos de lenguaje, conectados a bases de datos, al CRM propio y a APIs internas, de forma segura, trazable y eficiente en costos.
  • Prototipado y experimentación
    Transformar hipótesis de negocio en prototipos funcionales y medir su impacto con diseños experimentales, para decidir con evidencia qué escalar.
  • Puesta en producción y traspaso a TI
    Desplegar y mantener operativas las soluciones y, cuando requieran escalar a la infraestructura core, traspasarlas a TI según el estándar de handoff definido.

Importante destacar también que tendrás la posibilidad de ser parte de un equipo sólido, con foco en la mejora continua y con reales oportunidades de desarrollo profesional.

attributes.title: Back-end Software Engineer
attributes.description:
For us, Senior isn’t a matter of years or of how many technologies you know. It’s how you work:

  • You understand the problem before you solve it. You ask what the business or user actually needs, and sometimes the right answer is not to build anything.
  • You choose the simplest solution that works.
  • To you, complexity is a cost.
  • You make trade-offs explicit and explain your reasoning.
  • You own outcomes, not tasks.
  • You surface risks early, say when a plan is no longer realistic, and see things through after release.
  • You build things others can maintain.
  • Your code is clear, tested and easy to evolve without you in the room.
  • You think about what can go wrong. Failing dependencies, bad data, security and performance are part of the design, not an afterthought.
  • You act like a consultant.
  • You adapt how you communicate to engineers, product and clients, and you bring recommendations, not only problems.
  • You make your team better. You give thoughtful reviews, share what you know and help others grow, without becoming a bottleneck.
  • You keep learning. You get productive in unfamiliar systems and know when to ask for help.
  • You use AI responsibly. It makes you faster, but you understand and validate everything before it ships.
  • 4+ years building backends with Python and Django (Django REST Framework a big plus)
  • Solid experience with PostgreSQL in production, including schema changes on live systems
  • Hands-on experience with background processing (Celery, RabbitMQ, Redis or similar)
  • You’ve built and maintained integrations with third-party APIs and know what happens when they fail
  • You care about testing, code quality and constructive code reviews
  • You’ve supported your own work in production: monitoring, debugging and incidents don’t scare you
  • You’re comfortable in a large codebase shared with many engineers
  • C1 English: you’ll work daily with a US-based team, in meetings and in writing
attributes.projects:
At Zaelot, we are a progressive team-building company that specializes in developing scalable solutions for our enterprise clients. Our team consists of over 90 dedicated professionals across 9 different countries, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and collaboration. We prioritize continuous learning and improvement, ensuring that our employees are equipped with the skills needed to thrive in a rapidly changing tech landscape. Joining us as a Senior QA Analyst means becoming part of a passionate group of analysts, designers, and engineers committed to delivering exceptional quality in our products.

You’ll work on the core of that platform: a mature, large-scale Python/Django backend. Real people depend on it, so the job is more than writing code. You’ll solve real business problems, make sound technical decisions and own the outcome from the first conversation to a reliable release.

attributes.title: AI Automation Engineer — Contract
attributes.description:
Real experience building agent systems that run unattended

This is the requirement we cannot flex on. We are not looking for someone who has used AI tools, or built a chat interface over a document set. We are looking for someone who has built harnesses — a model with tools, memory and a task loop, running on a schedule, doing work without a person in the conversation. Tell us about one you built and shipped. What it did, what it got wrong, how you found out, and what you changed. We are as interested in the failure handling as in the capability.

The discipline that makes a model safe to leave running

Some of what you build here touches federally regulated processes. Getting an answer mostly right is not good enough, and neither is escalating everything and calling it safe.

What separates an automation we can trust from a demo is the scaffolding around the model, and we have strong views on it:

  • Deterministic checks bracket every model step. Validate the inputs before the model sees them, and validate the output against rules that do not involve a model. The reasoning sits in the middle, and it never certifies its own work — a verdict on correctness comes from a check the model cannot influence.
  • Missing is a failure, not a pass. An empty result, a partial record, a field that did not populate — these fail loudly. The most expensive bugs in this class of system are the ones where nothing appeared to go wrong.
  • Every output traces to the exact inputs that produced it. When a number is questioned six weeks later, you can show which records, which version of the logic, and which run produced it.
  • Confidence thresholds are explicit. What the system handles alone, what it flags for a person, and what it refuses to decide — decided deliberately and written down, not emergent.

You do not need to have used those words. You do need to have learned the lesson some other way, and to recognize why it matters more here than in most places. If your instinct on finding compliance logic in an unversioned script is that it needs fixing before it needs extending, you will do well here.

Our stack — ideally you know some of this

  • Python or Node for the pipelines. We are not precious about which
  • Agent harnesses — the orchestration layer around the model, not just the model. Claude Code and similar coding agents, especially used across a team; custom harnesses you have built yourself; anything where you have had to decide what the loop does, where it stops, and what happens when a step fails. This is the part of the stack we care most about
  • Agent frameworks and tool protocols — MCP, function calling, whatever you have used to give a model real capability
  • Browser automation — some of what we need to reach has no API
  • SQL and analytical databases — our data platform is ClickHouse
  • ERP data — SAP Business One, though you do not need to have worked in it
  • Source control and CI as habits, not as process imposed on you
attributes.projects:
About the role

BluPax is a pharmaceutical distributor. A lot of what keeps the business running is still done by hand — people pulling data out of one system every morning, checking it against another, and re-entering the result somewhere else. We are building a development team to change that, and this is the role that does it. You would build the automation layer: agents that run on a schedule, connect to the systems we already use, do the work, and escalate only the exceptions that need a person. Not a chatbot. Not a pilot. Software that runs unattended and that people come to rely on.

The first project

Our compliance team handles controlled substances, and two of their daily processes are the first targets. One is a high-volume inventory report assembled by hand every morning before the day starts. The other is an order review that checks proposed orders against customer and sales history under federal thresholds
attributes.functions:
• Build scheduled, autonomous pipelines: fetch the data, do the work, produce the output, deliver it — without a human starting it
  • Design the exception path. Clean cases should complete silently; the ones that need attention should reach the right person with the context to act
  • Connect to the systems we run — our ERP, our data platform, third-party tools, and web interfaces where no API exists
  • Build the deterministic guardrails and audit trail underneath all of it — input validation, output checks the model cannot influence, and traceability from any result back to the records and logic version that produced it
  • Capture user corrections as a feedback signal, so the system’s accuracy is measurable and improves
  • Work directly with the people whose jobs you are changing, and understand a process properly before automating it
  • Leave behind something maintainable — documented, in source control, and operable by someone who is not you

Checkr está creando una plataforma de datos para facilitar la toma de decisiones seguras y justas. Fundada en 2014, la tecnología y la sólida plataforma de datos de Checkr ayudan a clientes a evaluar los riesgos y garantizar la seguridad y el cumplimiento normativo para crear lugares de trabajo y comunidades de confianza.

Como Sr Software Engineer en Checkr, desempeñarás un papel fundamental en el avance de nuestro producto, en nuestra misión de construir la plataforma de datos del futuro. A lo largo del ciclo de desarrollo del producto, colaborarás con otros ingenieros y con tus contrapartes de producto para diseñar y entregar nuevas capacidades de plataforma e iniciativas clave de producto. Tu pasión por la excelencia técnica impulsará el progreso en la modernización de nuestro stack tecnológico, la simplificación de la arquitectura de sistemas y la automatización de flujos de trabajo manuales, para asegurar la escalabilidad y eficiencia de nuestra plataforma.

attributes.title: Full-Stack Developer
attributes.description:
• 2+ years of hands-on development experience. You’ve personally built features and fixed issues on real projects.

attributes.projects:
We’re hiring a developer to support our affiliate lead generation business by building landing pages, connecting forms to external systems, implementing conversion tracking, troubleshooting technical issues, and creating internal tools. This is not just an Elementor or page-building role. You’ll write custom code, work with APIs, fix backend issues, and help ensure leads and conversion data flow reliably through our systems.

You’ll work alongside an experienced developer and collaborate with media buyers and other stakeholders to support high-volume lead generation campaigns. The team focuses on building scalable, reliable solutions that improve lead delivery, tracking accuracy, and overall business performance.
attributes.functions:
• Build and update landing pages. Work in WordPress and Elementor to create pages, edit layouts, build forms, and fix mobile or browser issues. Write custom WordPress features. Work with PHP, custom plugins, hooks, custom post types, and Gravity Forms. Know when a task needs custom code rather than another plugin.
  • Connect forms to APIs. Validate submissions, create or update WordPress records, send leads to buyers and CRMs, and notify the right people. Make lead delivery reliable. Save submissions, log API responses, handle failed requests, and prevent duplicate deliveries. Make failures visible instead of letting leads disappear.
  • Set up and troubleshoot conversion tracking. Work with Meta, Google, and TikTok tracking, including browser pixels, server-side events, postbacks, and deduplication.
  • Find and fix problems in existing code. Investigate plugin conflicts, broken forms, missing conversions, API errors, and backend issues—even when documentation is incomplete.
  • Build tools, automations, and AI workflows. Create lead-routing logic, internal utilities, and integrations that reduce manual work. Use AI to help write and debug code, but understand and test what it produces.
  • Test and document your changes. Check the full workflow, not just whether the page loads. Use staging where possible, keep changes in version control, and leave clear notes so another developer can maintain your work.

attributes.title: Ingeniero/a de Terreno IA
attributes.description:
Nivel intermedio. Mínimo 2 años implementando soluciones reales.
Excluyentes:
  • Título profesional o técnico en informática, computación o afín, o experiencia equivalente demostrable.
  • Al menos 2 años construyendo soluciones que alguien usa hoy.
  • Se pide portafolio o casos concretos.
  • Experiencia implementando con LLMs vía API (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI o similar): prompts estructurados, salidas estructuradas y agentes con herramientas.
  • Python o Node.js con soltura para consumir y construir APIs REST, y manejo de datos (SQL, planillas, Excel/CSV a escala).
  • Experiencia con al menos una herramienta de orquestación de flujos (n8n, Make, Power Automate o similar) integrando sistemas de un cliente.
  • Capacidad de conversar con personas no técnicas, hacer preguntas, entender un proceso y explicar una solución en lenguaje simple.
  • Lo ponemos como excluyente a propósito.
  • Disponibilidad presencial en Santiago 3 días a la semana.
Cómo es la persona que buscamos:
  • Curiosa, con ganas de meterse en el problema. Le acomoda ir a un local, preguntar y observar.
  • Prefiere mostrar algo funcionando a explicar por qué no se pudo.
  • Sabe decir "esto no necesita IA" cuando no la necesita.
  • Estructurada, para sostener un ritmo semanal.

Lo que este cargo no es:
No es un desarrollador remoto que recibe tickets: el levantamiento en terreno es parte del trabajo. No es un consultor que entrega documentos: se entrega software funcionando. No es un perfil senior que hace todo solo: hay dirección de negocio y técnica cada semana, y eso es parte del diseño. No es un cargo de infraestructura cloud: no se pide AWS ni arquitectura de plataforma.
attributes.projects:
Sobre Usercode
Estamos buscando un nuevo Usercoder y este podrías ser tú! Usercode es una empresa tecnológica especializada en el desarrollo de software para instituciones públicas y organizaciones privadas. Nuestro foco son las tecnologías Cloud, la automatización y digitalización de procesos. Para comunicarnos y trabajar utilizamos Slack, Meet Hangout y Monday.
attributes.functions:
Buscamos un/a Ingeniero/a de Terreno IA: un perfil que convierte problemas reales de la operación de una empresa cliente en soluciones con IA que funcionan en su día a día. No desde una oficina: desde el lugar donde ocurre el problema, conversando con quienes lo viven y construyendo rápido para probar. La modalidad es híbrida 3+2: tres días a la semana presencial en el cliente (Santiago, oficina central y locales) levantando y validando, y dos días de desarrollo. El cargo reporta a la dirección técnica y la dirección de negocio donde se decide en conjunto el enfoque de cada caso.
Tus funciones principales serán:
Instalarte en la empresa cliente y levantar en terreno cómo funcionan hoy los procesos que se quieren mejorar: quién los hace, con qué datos, dónde se traba y cuánto tiempo se pierde. Traer ese levantamiento a la revisión semanal con el equipo de dirección, donde se define si el caso se resuelve con las herramientas que el cliente ya tiene (Copilot, Power Automate, planillas conectadas) o si requiere desarrollo. Construir la solución: agentes con LLM (API de OpenAI, Anthropic, Copilot Studio), automatizaciones (n8n, Make, Power Automate), integraciones con sistemas del cliente (correo, ERP, Buk, bases de datos) y, cuando corresponda, RAG sobre documentación interna. Probarla con los usuarios reales, ajustar y dejarla funcionando en producción. Medir el antes y el después (horas, errores, plazos) y documentar cada caso. Entrenar a un dueño interno para que la solución se sostenga sin ti. Sostener el ritmo del servicio: un objetivo mensual, un foco semanal y una entrega visible, con demo corta a los usuarios al cierre de cada semana.

attributes.title: Web App Full-Stack Engineer
attributes.description:
We’re looking for an engineer who can take full ownership with minimal oversight and deliver a consistently improving product.
  • 3+ years of experience shipping production web apps
  • Solid backend skills
  • Hands-on experience shipping AI features such as LLMs or computer vision
How we work: We value strong autonomy, clear ownership, and the ability to turn data and feedback into product improvements. You should enjoy testing, diagnosing issues, and resolving bugs quickly, while continuing to expand features in a steady, user-focused way. Strong communication and collaboration are essential, especially in a small team with direct founder access.
attributes.projects:
Niuro is recruiting a Web App Full-Stack Engineer to develop and improve a recruitment technology platform for secure online candidate assessments. Hiring teams use the platform to create tests, invite candidates, and review AI-detected flags for potential unauthorized AI use or document sharing.

You will take end-to-end engineering ownership of the existing web application, resolve production bugs, expand functionality, and improve testing, reliability, and performance. You will use performance data and user feedback to guide improvements across assessment setup, candidate testing, and results review.

You will work in a small team with direct access to the founders. The role requires strong backend skills and experience shipping production web applications and AI features using LLMs or computer vision, with a focus on keeping the product stable as its capabilities grow.
attributes.functions:
We’ll have you lead the web app end-to-end, building and advancing a working product while keeping quality high.
  • Own the web app end to end
  • Use performance data and user feedback to improve the product
  • Help make a working product great
  • Testing and bug resolution
You’ll contribute directly to day-to-day delivery in a small team with access to the founders, ensuring thoughtful execution and a strong understanding of what users need.
attributes.benefits: We provide the opportunity to participate in impactful and technically rigorous industrial data projects that drive innovation and professional growth. Our environment emphasizes technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous innovation. We support a 100% remote work model, allowing flexibility in your work location globally. We invest in career development through ongoing training programs and leadership opportunities. After successful completion of the initial contract, there is potential for long-term collaboration and stable, full-time employment. You’ll also benefit from strong administrative support, so you can focus on delivering exceptional results. If this sounds like the kind of ownership you want, we’d love to hear from you.
attributes.desirable:

attributes.projects:
Acerca de Checkr
Checkr está creando una plataforma de datos para facilitar la toma de decisiones seguras y justas. Fundada en 2014, la tecnología y la sólida plataforma de datos de Checkr ayudan a clientes a evaluar los riesgos y garantizar la seguridad y el cumplimiento normativo para crear lugares de trabajo y comunidades de confianza.

Como Sr. Software Engineer Backend en Checkr, desempeñarás un papel crucial en el avance de nuestro producto en nuestra misión de crear la plataforma de datos del futuro , colaborarás con otros ingenieros y homólogos de producto para diseñar y ofrecer nuevas capacidades de la plataforma e iniciativas clave de producto. Tu pasión por la excelencia técnica impulsará el progreso en la modernización de nuestra pila técnica, la simplificación de la arquitectura del sistema y la automatización de los flujos de trabajo manuales para garantizar la escalabilidad y la eficiencia de nuestra plataforma.
attributes.functions:
• Desarrollar nuevas capacidades de la plataforma y ofertas de productos, desde el diseño hasta el lanzamiento.
  • Encontrar el equilibrio entre la rapidez de comercialización y el crecimiento a largo plazo, diseñando con visión de futuro y construyendo para el presente.
  • Colaborar con el departamento de Productos para definir iniciativas del tamaño adecuado y elaborar una hoja de ruta que satisfaga las necesidades empresariales trimestre tras trimestre.
  • Preservar la buena voluntad de los clientes garantizando la disponibilidad del sistema, participando en turnos de guardia, atendiendo las solicitudes de asistencia y tomando medidas preventivas para mejorar la fiabilidad.
  • Ofrecer orientación a los ingenieros junior del equipo y de toda la organización.
  • Desempeñar un papel activo en la mejora continua de la organización de ingeniería mediante debates durante el almuerzo, presentaciones del equipo y revisiones con la alta dirección.
attributes.benefits:
• Un entorno de colaboración y rápido movimiento
  • Formar parte de una empresa internacional con sede en Estados Unidos

En Checkr, creemos que un entorno de trabajo híbrido fortalece la colaboración, impulsa la innovación y fomenta la conexión. Nuestras sedes principales son Denver, CO, San Francisco, CA, y Santiago, Chile.

attributes.description:

attributes.title: Technical Lead Full-Stack
attributes.description:
Se espera experiencia real en el diseño, definición y evolución de arquitecturas de sistemas, participando activamente en decisiones técnicas y no únicamente en la implementación de funcionalidades.

Node.js + TypeScript.
NestJS o frameworks backend equivalentes.
React / Next.js; idealmente experiencia con Ionic.
APIs REST y arquitecturas orientadas a servicios/microservicios.
PostgreSQL y/o bases relacionales.
MongoDB / DocumentDB u otras bases NoSQL.
Redis.

Arquitectura

DDD.
Arquitectura Hexagonal / Clean Architecture.
Event Driven Architecture.
Experiencia con Kafka, Pub/Sub o tecnologías equivalentes.
Diseño de sistemas distribuidos.
Manejo de concurrencia, idempotencia, retries y consistencia eventual.
Capacidad para definir cuándo usar procesamiento síncrono vs asíncrono.

Cloud / DevOps

Experiencia práctica en AWS, Azure o GCP.
Docker.
CI/CD.
Observabilidad con herramientas como Grafana, Kibana, New Relic o similares.

IA / AI Engineering — deseable

Experiencia integrando LLMs vía API.
RAG.
Vector databases / vector search.
Embeddings.
Agentes y tool calling.
attributes.projects: Proyecto orientado a la evolución y modernización de una plataforma digital, trabajando con Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS, React/Next.js, APIs y microservicios. El equipo es multidisciplinario, con desarrollo, arquitectura, producto, Data, Seguridad y DevOps. El rol combina liderazgo técnico y trabajo hands-on, participando en decisiones de arquitectura, code reviews, estándares, reducción de deuda técnica, discovery y desarrollo de nuevas soluciones, incluyendo IA.
attributes.functions:
Buscamos un/a Technical Lead Full Stack hands-on, con al menos 5 años de experiencia en desarrollo de software y trayectoria ejerciendo funciones de Technical Lead, Tech Lead o referente técnico dentro de equipos de desarrollo.
El perfil debe contar además con experiencia práctica en al menos uno de los principales proveedores cloud, como AWS, Azure o GCP, junto con conocimientos en Docker, CI/CD y herramientas de observabilidad como Grafana, Kibana, New Relic o similares.
A nivel de liderazgo técnico, esperamos una persona capaz de liderar decisiones de arquitectura, realizar code reviews, definir estándares de desarrollo y guiar técnicamente a desarrolladores senior, semi-senior y junior. Debe tener la capacidad de traducir requerimientos de negocio en soluciones técnicas, identificar deuda técnica, proponer estrategias de evolución y participar activamente en discovery, refinamientos y estimaciones.
También deberá relacionarse de manera fluida con áreas como Product, Arquitectura, Data, Seguridad, DevOps y negocio, teniendo la autonomía y criterio necesarios para cuestionar requerimientos o soluciones cuando técnicamente no sean adecuadas.
Es fundamental que sea un perfil hands-on, que continúe desarrollando, revisando código y participando directamente en la solución técnica. No buscamos un perfil enfocado exclusivamente en gestión o administración.
attributes.desirable:
Como conocimiento deseable, se valorará experiencia en AI Engineering, especialmente integración de LLMs vía API, RAG, vector databases o vector search, embeddings, agentes y tool calling.
En frontend, se requiere manejo de React y/o Next.js, siendo deseable experiencia con Ionic.

attributes.title: Front-end Software Engineer
attributes.description:
We are looking for a Lead Software Engineer with proven experience in Contentful and client-facing technical leadership.
  • Strong expertise in Contentful content modeling and space architecture, built according to best practices.
  • Experience with multi-space consolidation.
  • Hands-on work with content migration planning and execution.
  • Ability to design authoring templates that enable self-service for non-engineers (marketers).
  • Experience leading technical decisions and working directly with clients.
  • Advanced English (written and spoken) for daily communication with US-based clients.
We value clear communication, ownership, and the ability to coordinate across engineering, marketing, and product stakeholders. You should be comfortable taking lead on technical strategy, translating it into practical implementation steps, and helping the team follow consistent standards.
attributes.projects: At Zaelot, we build scalable, enterprise-grade solutions with a collaborative team across 9 countries. In this project, we support a client’s content platform by owning the Contentful content model and space architecture. You will lead multi-space consolidation efforts, define best practices the team follows, and ensure content migrations are planned, executed safely, and remain repeatable. The work includes enabling self-service content creation through authoring templates, while collaborating closely with the client’s engineering, marketing, and product teams to deliver a clean, maintainable structure without disrupting live sites.
attributes.functions:
You will lead the ownership of the Contentful content model and space architecture, establishing the best practices our team follows.

  • Lead multi-space consolidation: merge separate Contentful spaces into a clean, maintainable structure without disrupting live sites.
  • Plan, oversee, and support content migrations that run safely and are repeatable.
  • Design authoring templates so marketers can create and publish content independently, without engineering help.
  • Act as the main technical contact with the client’s engineering, marketing, and product teams.
  • Guide and support other engineers on the project through technical decisions and day-to-day collaboration.
attributes.benefits:
• 20 days of paid vacation after completing one year.
  • Referral program for successful candidate recommendations.
  • Finder's fee.
  • Comprehensive training and certification programs for continuous professional development.
  • Work-from-home aid to create a comfortable remote setup.
  • English classes to support communication and career growth.
  • Fitness program and coaching sessions to support personal and professional development.
  • Profit sharing reflecting our commitment to collective success.
attributes.desirable:
• JavaScript/TypeScript experience for writing migration scripts and working with Contentful tooling.
  • Experience with Contentful Migration CLI, Contentful Management API, and App Framework.
  • Familiarity with Contentful GraphQL and Content Delivery APIs.

attributes.title: Principal Engineer
attributes.description:
Exceptional Backend Engineering & Architectural Judgment — 8+ years of professional backend engineering experience at a Senior/Staff/Principal/Architect level, with exceptional hands-on development capability and significant production Java experience. Experience with Spring Boot, Spring Security and Hibernate/JPA strongly preferred.

Deep Relational Data Architecture Expertise — Proven ownership of complex production relational data models at real scale.

Strong System Design & API Architecture Capability — Demonstrated ability to design sophisticated production systems and REST APIs, understand distributed-system tradeoffs, with real experience improving an already-established codebase, not only building greenfield. Strong PostgreSQL experience (Cocoon currently uses Aurora PostgreSQL).

AI-Native Engineering Capability— Demonstrated ability to use modern AI-assisted development tools to materially improve engineering productivity and quality, while applying the technical judgment needed to critically evaluate AI-generated work.

Production Engineering Discipline — Strong understanding of application security, automated testing, observability, reliability, performance and maintainability. Builds systems designed to operate reliably in production, not simply function in development.

Technical Leadership & Independent Judgment — Experience directing senior engineers and serving as a trusted technical authority. Comfortable making consequential decisions with incomplete information, surfacing risks early, challenging assumptions, and recommending a clear path forward.

Production Applied-AI Experience (Highly Preferred) — Meaningful hands-on experience implementing and operating production AI, LLM, agentic, multimodal, or computer-vision capabilities, including architecture, evaluation, retrieval, reliability, and production operations

Strong Cloud & Production Infrastructure Fluency — Experience with AWS-hosted production systems (EC2, S3, RDS/Aurora, IAM, VPC networking), containers, CI/CD and modern cloud deployment architecture.

How You Work

Owner's Mindset, Professional Maturity & Communication

  • Operates like an owner, not a ticket-taker.
  • Takes responsibility for outcomes, moves quickly without sacrificing quality, disagrees productively, communicates clearly, and credibly represents Cocoon with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Genuine Engineering Craft

  • Still loves building software and is comfortable operating without a large engineering organization around them.

Thrives in a Startup Environment

  • Acts independently while collaborating effectively within a small team. Knows how to get things done and works quickly without requiring a high degree of oversight.
attributes.projects:
Cocoon connects property intelligence, homeowner engagement and service fulfillment to help homeowners better maintain and protect their homes while enabling insurance carriers and other partners to move from identifying property risk to addressing and verifying risk mitigation.

To take the next step in growing our business, we are seeking an exceptional Principal Engineer who will inherit our fully functional platform. We are looking for someone who wants to become a long-term member of Cocoon's core team, participate meaningfully in the company's success.

You will understand that system deeply, determine what should be preserved, identify what should be improved and lead the evolution of the platform's technical foundation in line with product and business strategy.

Serving as Cocoon's primary internal technical authority and source of technical truth, you will own technical architecture and engineering decisions in alignment with the company's product and business priorities.
attributes.functions:
Technical Architecture & Leadership

  • Serve as Cocoon's primary internal authority on backend architecture, data architecture, system design and engineering quality.
  • Own technical architecture and engineering decisions.
  • Spearhead Cocoon's efforts to integrate AI-driven capabilities into its products, platform and engineering workflows.

Hands-On Backend Engineering

  • Remain deeply hands-on in Cocoon's codebase and personally develop production software.
  • Enter an established codebase, understand it quickly and determine what should be retained, refactored or replaced.
  • Help shape product ideas and requirements alongside Cocoon team members before specifications are finalized.

Data Architecture

  • Lead evolution of Cocoon's existing data architecture into a sophisticated relational domain model.
  • Define schemas, relationships, data-access patterns and integrity standards.
  • Develop safe migration strategies for evolving an active production database.
  • Account for both structured and unstructured information as Cocoon's AI capabilities expand.
  • Build a data foundation capable of supporting substantially greater intelligence, automation and scale over time.

AI-Native Engineering

  • Be AI-native in how you work, actively using AI development tools to improve engineering speed and quality.

Infrastructure & DevOps Oversight

  • Ensure infrastructure decisions remain aligned with Cocoon's application architecture.
  • Maintain appropriate visibility into security, reliability, deployment architecture, performance & cost.
  • Provide technical direction and oversight to Cocoon's outsourced AWS/DevOps engineer.

Enterprise & Partner Technical Leadership

  • As required, represent Cocoon in technical discussions with insurance carriers, technology partners and other external stakeholders.
attributes.benefits:
• Meaningful equity options and participation in the company's long-term success
  • Direct working relationship with Cocoon's Founder & CEO
  • Genuine ownership of Cocoon's technical architecture and engineering direction
  • Opportunity to remain deeply hands-on while operating at the highest technical level in the company
  • Small, senior team with substantial individual autonomy and impact
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Opportunity to shape how AI is embedded into both Cocoon's products and engineering organization

Compensation: Competitive compensation + equity options

attributes.title: Senior Go Software Engineer
attributes.description:
Required

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience with strong Go expertise.
  • Solid understanding of REST API design, gRPC, and Protocol Buffers.
  • Experience integrating third-party APIs, including handling protocol and format translation.
  • Familiarity with async and event-driven patterns (message queues, workflow engines, or equivalent).
  • Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and cloud infrastructure (AWS).
  • Able to read and extend existing codebases confidently without over-engineering.
  • Professional working English, written and spoken.
attributes.projects:
The Configurations Lab helps companies integrate modern AI capabilities that creates meaningful impact. We work across all industries to bring understanding to how AI agents can become partners and supercharge results.

We are building a modern connectivity layer between AI-driven channels — conversational agents, chatbots, and partner-facing APIs — and a large-scale insurance platform. The existing architecture was designed for browser-based customer journeys and needs to evolve to support AI-native experiences end-to-end. You will contribute to a focused engineering effort building the services and integration patterns that make this possible. The work combines greenfield API design with pragmatic integration of existing backend systems. You coordinate with an internal technical lead on architecture, scope, and priorities, while retaining autonomy over how you work.
attributes.functions:
• Build and maintain Go microservices that expose a clean, unified API surface across quote, pricing, policy, and payment operations.
  • Design integration adapters that abstract protocol heterogeneity (REST, gRPC, SOAP, XML) behind consistent internal interfaces.
  • Implement async and event-driven patterns to replace synchronous polling in payment and policy lifecycle flows.
  • Contribute to API contract definitions (OpenAPI, Protobuf) as the source of truth for new interfaces.
  • Write unit and integration tests against real backing services.
  • Take part in design reviews, code review, and async collaboration across time zones.

ENGAGEMENT & WORKING ARRANGEMENTS

This is an independent contractor (B2B) engagement, not employment. You provide services through your own company or as an independent professional, invoice for your work, and remain responsible for your own taxes, equipment, and statutory contributions.

  • Fully remote, open to contractors based in LatAm
  • You collaborate with a team of 4–5 engineers and coordinate with an internal technical lead on architecture and priorities. As an independent contractor, you manage your own working methods and schedule.
  • Async-first collaboration.

SCHEDULE & MEETINGS

Some recurring meetings, such as design reviews and planning, are scheduled during European working hours. Otherwise the engagement is async and self-directed.
attributes.benefits: Competitive contractor rate, aligned with senior-level experience, invoiced under an independent services agreement.
attributes.desirable:
• OpenAPI contract-first development experience.
  • Familiarity with Kafka or event streaming platforms.
  • Background in fintech, insurtech, or regulated payment integrations.
  • Experience with secrets management in production environments (Vault or equivalent).

attributes.title: Desarrollador/a Drupal Full-Stack

attributes.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
attributes.description:

Full stack

  • Experiencia senior desarrollando aplicaciones full stack en producción, con responsabilidad de punta a punta sobre las funcionalidades que construyes.

  • Conocimiento práctico de SaaS B2B multi-tenant: separación de datos, autorización y trazabilidad.
  • Diseño de sistemas resilientes y seguros: prevención de fallos, recuperación ante errores y capas de defensa frente a amenazas externas.
attributes.projects:
En LeyDeDatos construimos el software con el que las empresas gestionan sus obligaciones de protección de datos: registro de actividades de tratamiento, consentimientos, derechos de los titulares y clasificación de datos con IA. La nueva regulación chilena está obligando a miles de organizaciones a ordenar sus procesos ahora, y nosotros construimos la herramienta con la que lo harán. Lo que sale a producción hoy lo usan clientes reales mañana.

El desafío técnico es de los buenos: un SaaS B2B multi-tenant donde agentes de IA operan sobre información personal de organizaciones distintas. Aislamiento entre tenants, permisos y trazabilidad son parte del diseño de todo, incluidos los agentes. Aquí la IA agéntica no es un experimento: es producto.

Trabajamos con producto e ingeniería muy cerca, y cada persona tiene ownership real sobre lo que construye y voz en las decisiones. Quien entre ahora va a ayudar a definir cómo construimos software y, con el tiempo, a marcar su rumbo técnico.
attributes.functions:
El rol tiene dos caras, y las dos importan:

  • IA agéntica en el producto. Nuestro producto clasifica datos personales, automatiza flujos de cumplimiento y asiste a los usuarios con agentes. Vas a diseñar esos agentes: qué herramientas exponen, cómo se orquestan, cómo se evalúan y qué límites tienen. Como tocan datos personales de varias organizaciones, un agente tiene que respetar permisos, aislamiento entre tenants y trazabilidad igual que cualquier otra parte del sistema.
  • IA agéntica en el desarrollo. Trabajamos con agentes de código integrados al flujo diario. Vas a mantener el contexto que hace que esos agentes funcionen bien en nuestro proyecto: documentación en Markdown, skills, reglas por repositorio y servidores MCP. Y vas a ser responsable de lo que llega a producción, lo haya escrito un humano o un agente.

En el día a día vas a:

  • Construir funcionalidades completas con TypeScript, Node.js, React o Next.js, APIs y persistencia, desde la definición del problema hasta su operación en producción.
  • Diseñar e integrar agentes en el producto: tool use, orquestación multi-paso, RAG, guardrails, evals y control de costos de inferencia.
  • Definir cómo los agentes acceden a datos personales respetando permisos, aislamiento multi-tenant y auditoría.
  • Mantener el contexto de los agentes de código del equipo (Markdown, skills, reglas, MCP).
  • Desplegar y operar tus cambios en GCP, considerando disponibilidad, rendimiento y costos.
  • Escribir pruebas, revisar código y aportar a la observabilidad de los servicios y de los agentes.
attributes.benefits:
Tendrás ownership sobre funcionalidades relevantes, colaboración directa con el equipo y espacio para crecer hacia responsabilidades técnicas de mayor alcance.

  • Modalidad híbrida en Santiago, Chile, con horario flexible.
  • Contrato a plazo fijo inicial y luego indefinido. El primer período funciona como ajuste mutuo; la intención es continuar en indefinido.
  • Jornada completa.
  • Computador provisto por la empresa.

attributes.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
attributes.description:
• 3+ years of professional software engineering, solutions engineering, technical consulting, or similar experience.
  • Strong software development skills with experience building real production applications.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Experience working directly with customers, business stakeholders, or non-technical teams.
  • Ability to take an unclear problem, ask the right questions, and independently move toward a practical technical solution.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, databases, cloud services, and modern application architecture.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and comfort working in fast-moving and sometimes ambiguous environments.
  • Ability to balance technical quality, delivery speed, business priorities, and scope.

The strongest Forward Deployed Engineers do not wait for perfectly defined requirements.

You should be comfortable hearing something like, "We have this business problem, but we are not sure exactly what the solution should be," and then working with stakeholders to understand the problem, determine what should be built, design the architecture, and help deliver the solution.

You should enjoy moving between business conversations, architecture discussions, and hands-on engineering work, sometimes within the same day.
attributes.projects:
We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who can work directly with business stakeholders to understand complex problems, design practical technical solutions, and help take those solutions from concept through production.

This is a hands-on engineering role that sits between software engineering, solution architecture, and technical consulting. You should be comfortable talking with business users, asking the right questions, translating their needs into technical requirements, and then actively building the solution.

You will work across AI, web applications, APIs, cloud infrastructure, integrations, and enterprise systems. Many projects will begin with an ambiguous business problem rather than a detailed technical specification, so you must be comfortable taking ownership and figuring out the right path forward.

We take the time to understand our clients, identifying opportunities where automation can drive significant ROI.
attributes.functions:
• Work directly with business and technical stakeholders to understand workflows, pain points, and business objectives.
  • Turn ambiguous business problems into clear technical requirements, architectures, and implementation plans.
  • Design and build production software, APIs, integrations, automation, and AI-enabled applications.
  • Rapidly build prototypes and proofs of concept, validate them with stakeholders, and evolve successful solutions into production systems.
  • Work across frontend, backend, databases, cloud infrastructure, APIs, and AI services as needed.

  • Integrate solutions with existing enterprise systems, APIs, databases, and internal platforms.

  • Troubleshoot technical and production issues and drive problems through resolution.
  • Identify reusable components, patterns, and approaches that can improve future projects.
  • Take ownership of business outcomes rather than simply completing assigned development tickets.

  • Git con criterio: branches, pull requests, code review, y capacidad de hacer rollback sin que se te note en la cara.

attributes.projects:
En Fullkom hacemos ecommerce: implementamos, mantenemos y hacemos crecer las tiendas de nuestros clientes. No vendemos horas de desarrollo sueltas.
El equipo se organiza en dos frentes. Por un lado los KAM y los Store Managers, que gestionan la relación con cada cuenta, entienden el negocio del cliente y llevan las definiciones. Por el otro, el frente técnico, que es donde entrás vos.

¿Cómo trabajamos?

  • Explicás sin tecnicismos. Podés decirle a un KAM por qué lo que pide no se hace en tres días, de forma que lo entienda y pueda defenderlo frente a su cliente.
  • Negociás. Cuando el backlog está lleno y llegan tres pedidos más, no decís que sí a todo ni te escondés: ordenás y argumentás.
  • Priorizás bajo presión. Cuando caen urgencias de tres cuentas distintas, sabés cuál va primero y por qué.
  • Preguntás antes de asumir. La mitad de los bugs de ecommerce son requerimientos mal entendidos.
  • Levantás la mano temprano. Preferimos enterarnos de un problema el martes y no el viernes a las 19:00.
attributes.functions:
La mayor parte de tu semana es código sobre VTEX IO: componentes React sobre Store Framework, apps custom, customizaciones de checkout y resolución de bugs en tiendas que están en producción, sobre varias cuentas en paralelo. El resto se reparte entre definir cómo se resuelven los requerimientos que traen los KAM, conectar tiendas con sistemas externos y destrabar al equipo cuando se cruza con algo técnico.

En concreto:

  • Desarrollo y soporte evolutivo sobre VTEX. Programás funcionalidades nuevas y resolvés incidencias sobre tiendas en producción. Definís el estándar de calidad del código.
  • Definición técnica y estimación. Tomás lo que traen los E-KAM y los Store Managers, evaluás viabilidad, dimensionás el esfuerzo en Jira y negociás qué entra y qué no. Sos quien pone el número y quien lo defiende.
  • Prioridades. Ordenás el backlog técnico según impacto y riesgo, y comunicás los trade-offs al equipo comercial en un lenguaje que puedan usar.
  • Integraciones. Conectás las tiendas con ERPs, WMS, CRMs y marketplaces mediante APIs REST y GraphQL.
  • Soporte al equipo interno. Sos el punto de apoyo de Store Managers y E-KAM cuando se traban con incidencias, bugs complejos o bloqueos críticos.
  • QA y seguridad. Definís y ejecutás los protocolos de control antes de cada pase a producción, y mantenés las plataformas actualizadas para evitar vulnerabilidades.
  • Mejora continua. Proponés optimizaciones de performance y arquitectura que impacten la conversión, y automatizaciones que le bajen la carga manual al equipo.

Lo que no te vamos a esconder: hay tickets, hay urgencias y hay CyberDay. Si te gusta que el trabajo tenga ritmo y variedad, te va a encajar. Si buscás un único proyecto largo y tranquilo, este rol no es ese.
attributes.benefits: Por qué acá y no en otro lado: vas a tener autonomía real sobre las decisiones técnicas y sobre las prioridades, no vas a pelear tu criterio contra tres capas de aprobación. Y vas a ver el impacto de lo que hacés en el negocio de marcas concretas, no en un backlog abstracto.

attributes.projects:
About Convo Communications LLC

Founded in March 2009, Convo is the world’s largest Deaf-owned business, with more than 500 employees serving five countries in ten languages. Convo believes conversations are essential to connection, access, and opportunity. By creating technology and services that address the experience deprivation many Deaf people face, Convo works to improve everyday communication and create lasting positive impact for Deaf individuals and the people around them.

About the role

The Software Engineer II is a key member of the Engineering team, responsible for designing, building, and maintaining reliable software that supports Convo’s mission-critical communication platform. The role requires sound technical judgment, clear communication, and the ability to work across legacy systems and modern microservices. Engineers are expected to manage ambiguity, identify risks, make thoughtful trade-offs, and deliver production-ready code in an always-on environment.
attributes.functions:
System Architecture & Technical Alignment

Design and implement services and features within established architectural patterns, contributing to technical designs and implementation plans while collaborating with senior engineers on broader system impact. Evaluate approaches and trade-offs to support consistency, scalability, reliability, security, privacy, and compliance across the platform.

Software Development & Delivery

Develop, test, and deploy production-ready software with appropriate automated testing. Balance delivery speed with system stability and maintainability, applying sound judgment when refactoring existing systems or implementing pragmatic fixes. Document technical decisions, communicate trade-offs clearly, participate in code reviews, and follow established engineering standards and best practices.

Operational Ownership & Risk Management

Identify technical risks, performance bottlenecks, and system weaknesses, proposing solutions and partnering with senior engineers on higher-impact improvements. Participate in production support, incident response, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and follow-up remediation. Contribute to monitoring, logging, and alerting practices that improve system health and reliability.

Documentation & Communication

Create and maintain clear technical documentation, implementation notes, architectural context, and code-level guidance. Use strong written communication to keep work, decisions, risks, and open questions visible and accessible in a distributed environment.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with Product, Operations, and Engineering teams to understand requirements and deliver reliable technical solutions. Collaborate effectively across time zones using tools such as Slack, Jira, and shared documentation, while contributing to continuous improvements in system reliability, developer efficiency, and operational clarity.

attributes.projects:
Vequity builds an M&A deal-sourcing platform. We aggregate + resolve data on millions of companies so acquirers can find targets that never make it to a broker. The backend is .NET 10 / EF Core / PostgreSQL, the frontend is Angular, and Python powers our data and LLM-automation pipelines. Temporal is used long-running workflows. LLM-driven agents used for entity resolution, enrichment, etc among other tasks.

Why Vequity?

Ownership here is reality. The team is small enough that every engineer owns a domain outright. Your backlog is yours, your roadmap input goes straight to the founders, and nobody sits between you and the decision. The flip side is accountability: what ships in your area is yours too.

You'll work at the frontier of LLM engineering, not on the sidelines of it. Our agents do entity resolution, enrichment, and research automation in production, and we evaluate and iterate on them like any other system — with harnesses, gold datasets, and bake-offs across models.
attributes.functions_headline: The Role: Own Your Area End-to-End
attributes.functions:
You will own features end-to-end across the full stack: Angular UI, .NET APIs and data models, and Python automation where your area touches our LLM pipelines.

One thing is non-negotiable. You must own the business requirements for your area and proactively maintain its product backlog. We will give you acceptance criteria, but you are expected to know your domain well enough to spot the gaps, propose the next features, and keep your backlog groomed without being asked. If you want fully-specified tickets handed to you, this role is not a fit.

A routine week: you ship a feature across Angular, .NET, and Python; you write or sharpen the acceptance criteria for the next one; you prune and reprioritize your backlog based on what shipping just taught you; you flag the requirement that no longer makes sense before anyone builds against it.

Success is measured on two axes: features shipped working in production, and the health of your backlog — whether the next most valuable thing in your area is already defined when it's time to build it.
attributes.benefits:
We pay competitively for the LATAM market and we’re transparent about it.

  • Time off: Manage your own schedule. We trust you.
  • Health: $150/month health and wellness stipend.
  • Engagement: B2B contract. 30-day mutual notice.

How we work

  • Fully remote. We are based in Denver, Colorado (MT, UTC-7). You can work from Colombia, Argentina, Brazil, Chile, or anywhere in the Americas with strong overlap.
  • Same time zone. We expect significant daily overlap with Central Standard Time (CT). LATAM time zones are ideal — this is a key reason we’re hiring in the region.
  • Async-first. We write things down. Docs, Loom videos, and thoughtful PR descriptions are the norm. Meetings happen when they’re the fastest path to clarity, not by default.
  • Small team, direct access. You will work directly with the Head of Engineering and the founder. No middle management. Your work ships fast.

La persona seleccionada será responsable de construir y ajustar soluciones con foco en calidad y continuidad, participando en el ciclo completo de entrega. Valoramos el compromiso con el cliente, la capacidad de trabajar en equipo y una comunicación clara para alinear avances y riesgos.

  • Conocimiento en Ambientes de Desarrollo
  • Dominio de COBOL.
  • Conocimiento de JCL.
  • Experiencia con DB2.
  • Conocimiento/experiencia con VSAM.
  • Uso de Visual Studio Code en el flujo de desarrollo.

  • Experiencia dentro de los últimos 6 meses en BancoEstado.

  • Orientación al detalle y rigor al trabajar con batch, datos y dependencias.
  • Responsabilidad y compromiso por cumplir estándares y tiempos de entrega.
  • Trabajo colaborativo y buena coordinación con análisis, QA y operación.
  • Comunicación efectiva para reportar avances, bloqueos y resultados de pruebas.
  • Aprendizaje continuo para adaptarse a cambios del cliente y mejoras del producto.
attributes.projects: En BC Tecnología somos una consultora TI enfocada en diseñar soluciones, crear equipos ágiles, desarrollar proyectos y entregar servicios de soporte y administración IT. Buscamos integrar a un perfil especializado en COBOL y tecnologías mainframe como JCL, DB2 y VSAM, capaz de trabajar dentro de los estándares del cliente. El objetivo es asegurar continuidad, calidad y evolución del software, coordinando actividades de desarrollo, verificación y entrega en un equipo ágil.

  • Experiencia en desarrollo de Stored Procedures / procedimientos almacenados.

  • Experiencia en creación y planificación de Jobs (programación de tareas).

  • Orientación a la calidad y a la continuidad operativa (seguimiento de ejecuciones y resolución oportuna).
  • Buenas prácticas de documentación y comunicación con el equipo.
  • Pensamiento analítico para identificar causas raíz en fallas de batch y en integraciones.
  • Proactividad para proponer mejoras en rendimiento, robustez y mantenibilidad.
  • Trabajo colaborativo para coordinar con stakeholders técnicos durante el ciclo de diseño, implementación y soporte.
attributes.projects: En BC Tecnología impulsamos soluciones e integraciones para clientes de servicios financieros, seguros, retail y gobierno, con un enfoque claro en el cliente, metodologías ágiles y desarrollo de productos. Por 6 años hemos diseñado e implementado capacidades acorde a las necesidades reales de cada organización, formando equipos en Infraestructura TI, Desarrollo de Software y Unidades de Negocio. Para un proyecto tecnológico orientado a la actualización y transferencia de información entre sistemas, buscamos un/a Desarrollador/a Batch y Automatización de Procesos. El rol se integrará al equipo para participar en el diseño, desarrollo, implementación y optimización de procesos automatizados, asegurando la continuidad operacional mediante monitoreo, resolución de incidentes y correcta documentación de lo implementado.
attributes.functions:
• Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener procesos Batch para actualización y procesamiento de información.

attributes.title: Shopify Technical Specialist
attributes.description:
• 2+ years hands-on with Shopify and its app ecosystem. You've lived in the admin.
  • You know how apps inject themselves into themes, how metafields work, what breaks when apps overlap.
  • Bonus for Rebuy, Klaviyo, Recharge, review apps (Okendo/Judge.me/Stamped), or loyalty apps.
  • You figure things out. This is the most important line in this post. You will regularly be asked to configure apps you've never touched.
  • The expectation is that you read the docs, poke the settings, test in a safe environment, and come back with it done — or with a specific, researched question ("the app can't do X natively; here are two workarounds, which do you prefer?").
  • If your instinct when stuck is to ask "what should I do?" this role will make us both miserable.
  • You verify your own work. "Done" means checked, not just clicked.
  • If you migrate 1,400 reviews, you tell me how you confirmed all 1,400 arrived.
  • Strong written English, and conversational spoken English — enough for an occasional call or screen-share walkthrough. Day-to-day communication is written.
  • Async-first — most communication is Slack tickets and written updates.
  • Some working-hours overlap with US Pacific time for same-day questions.
attributes.projects:
Commerce Theory is a technical ecommerce consultancy based in California. We manage the Shopify, Klaviyo, and app stacks for a roster of US DTC and CPG brands — food, wellness, supplements, and consumer goods — as their outsourced technical team.

This is one specific role on our team: Shopify Technical Specialist, reporting directly to the founder. You'll work from our internal ticket queue executing well-specified technical tasks on the stores we manage — app configuration, store-to-store migrations, loyalty/reviews setup, Klaviyo segment changes, and QA. Every ticket has a defined outcome; how you get there is up to you. No account managers, no layered approvals, no pointless meetings.

We're async-first and ticket-based, with AI tools (Claude) as a core part of the workflow — you should be excited about that, not threatened by it. Strong performance grows into more hours, broader scope, and a senior technical seat on our team.
attributes.functions:
You'll get tickets, not vague requests. Every task comes with a clear definition of done. Examples of real work from my queue:
  • Replicate a Rebuy Smart Cart configuration from one store to another, matching styling and rules exactly
  • Set up a new loyalty + reviews stack on a store in a non-live state, ready for launch review
  • Migrate all reviews from one app to another and verify the counts match — prove nothing was lost
  • Adjust Klaviyo sending segments per spec, and confirm downstream flows still reference the right segments
  • QA app configurations across storefronts, document discrepancies
Success is simple: tickets closed to spec, verified by you before handoff, with minimal back-and-forth. The best version of this role is someone I can hand ambiguous app-ecosystem problems to and trust the outcome.
attributes.benefits:
• Hourly $16–28 USD, independent contractor, invoice-based
  • Hours that grow with performance, across a portfolio of our clients
  • Direct work with a senior operator
  • Fully async and remote: you set your own schedule, work from anywhere
  • Clearly specified tasks, fast feedback, and pay that reflects skill, not seat time
  • Paid at your full rate from the test task onward — we never ask for free work
attributes.desirable:

  • Shopify Admin API / GraphQL for scripted checks and bulk operations
  • GA4 and Meta pixel/CAPI familiarity — enough to verify tracking survived a change

Because you will manage a high volume of content across multiple client websites, you must be detail-oriented, organized and comfortable following different instructions for each client. You should communicate problems promptly, meet deadlines and work independently without sacrificing accuracy.
attributes.projects: We are a specialized digital marketing agency helping law firms grow their online visibility. Our small, collaborative team includes SEO strategists, account managers, writers and web specialists. We publish more than 100 pieces of content and 400 images monthly across different WordPress environments. This role connects our content team with our clients’ websites by uploading, formatting and quality-checking content before publication.
attributes.functions:
What’s This Position About?

We are hiring a WordPress Content Publishing Specialist with junior-level front-end development skills. This person will publish and format at least 100 pieces of content monthly, each containing at least four images.

This is more technical than a basic content-upload position. Candidates must confidently navigate different WordPress environments, including custom ACF layouts, Elementor, Gutenberg and custom templates. Working knowledge of HTML, CSS and JavaScript is required.


Who Will This Role Work With?

The specialist will work with our SEO managers, account managers, writers, editors and web-development support. They must communicate progress, identify missing information and promptly report technical problems.


What Will They Be Responsible For?

  • Publishing and formatting at least 100 content pieces monthly.
  • Adding and optimizing at least four images per piece.
  • Structuring headings, lists, tables, links and calls to action.
  • Working with ACF, Elementor and other WordPress layouts.
  • Using HTML and CSS to resolve routine formatting issues.
  • Adding metadata, internal links and image alt text.
  • Checking desktop and mobile layouts before publishing.
  • Following each client’s instructions and tracking completed work.

Basic knowledge of on-page SEO is strongly preferred.


How Will Success Be Measured?

Success will be based on completing at least 100 pieces monthly, meeting 95% of deadlines, achieving 95% first-review accuracy and publishing content without broken layouts, links or missing images. The candidate should become capable of handling routine WordPress publishing independently after onboarding.
attributes.benefits: This is a fully remote, long-term opportunity with consistent monthly work. You will receive clear client-specific instructions while working with a small, experienced digital marketing team. The role offers exposure to different WordPress environments and opportunities to strengthen your development, publishing and SEO skills. We value dependable team members and provide greater independence as trust and experience grow.
attributes.desirable: Experience with on-page SEO, Yoast or Rank Math will help you correctly manage headings, metadata and internal links. Familiarity with Canva, Photoshop, image compression and WebP conversion is helpful for preparing website images. Experience with legal content, digital marketing agencies, basic PHP, custom WordPress themes or project-management software will also strengthen your application.

attributes.projects: Objetivos del cargo (Misión): Liderar la implementación, desarrollo y entrega de soluciones de software de alta calidad, asegurando la mantenibilidad, escalabilidad y buenas prácticas en el código, bajo la estrategia técnica de la compañía. Asegura la construcción de software verificado, seguro y de alto rendimiento, manteniendo la excelencia técnica en la ejecución y contribuyendo a la creación de valor mediante el desarrollo de ecosistemas digitales robustos.
attributes.functions:
Desarrollar componentes y soluciones de software aplicando arquitectura hexagonal (Ports & Adapters) para garantizar el desacoplamiento técnico. Implementar principios SOLID y patrones de diseño avanzado en Node.js para asegurar un código mantenible y extensible. Construir y desplegar servicios escalables y resilientes en infraestructura cloud (AWS/Azure). Implementar soluciones basadas en eventos (event-driven architecture) y microservicios, asegurando la integración eficiente con servicios core. Resguardar la calidad técnica a lo largo de todo el ciclo: revisar, validar y autorizar el diseño de la solución y los cambios antes de su integración y puesta en producción, garantizando pruebas, seguridad, documentación y trazabilidad.
Definir la estrategia técnica para la entrega híbrida entre agentes de IA, equipos internos y proveedores, estableciendo lineamientos y criterios de aceptación. Gobernar el uso de agentes en su flujo de valor: aplicar mínimo privilegio, vetting de skills/MCPs y un nivel de autonomía proporcional al riesgo de cada cambio. Construir y curar el contexto y la documentación como código de su dominio (reglas de negocio, glosario, skills, plantillas), alimentando el repositorio técnico institucional.
Asegurar seguridad y calidad por diseño y pipelines como autoridad de evidencia para auditoría (ISO 27001). Aplicar los estándares, principios y arquitecturas de referencia definidos por la Subgerencia de Arquitectura TI, escalando oportunamente las desviaciones. Supervisar el cumplimiento de estándares técnicos y calidad de arquitectura por parte de proveedores y partners. How You Work:

  • You state hard technical truths plainly. We would far rather hear "that's not possible yet — here's what is" than be told what we want to hear.
  • You are resourceful about building what doesn't exist yet.
attributes.projects:
Sugar Holdings is a founder-led company building a stealth consumer AI product. Small, scrappy, moving fast, with big dreams.
We believe the next generation of consumer AI won’t be chatbots — it will be presences. Something persistent and personal that remembers you, grows with you, and shows up when you need it. Most AI products reset every time you open them. We’re building the opposite: a relationship that compounds.
The honest challenge: the technology we depend on is expensive, immature, and fast-moving. Some of what we need doesn’t exist off the shelf — vendors are building it with us. Making it feel seamless, affordable, and reliable is the hardest problem in the company, and it’s why this role exists.
attributes.functions:
• Real-Time Orchestration Layer: A backend router and state machine that determines, in real time, which technology is active, and switches between them invisibly. This is the architectural core.
  • Session Lifecycle Management: Starting, stopping, and resuming live streaming sessions on demand, under strict latency and cost constraints.
  • Real-time Voice Pipeline: Wake-phrase, hands-free, sub-1.5-second end-to-end response in noisy ambient conditions, with real turn-taking and interruption handling.
  • LLM Harness: Middleware enforcing persona consistency, structured memory injection, safety guardrails, and server-side deterministic rules. Not prompt engineering; a production system.
  • Persistent Memory Architecture: Structured session records and living summaries that compound across sessions and days, injected into every subsequent interaction.
  • Camera Perception Layer: Including confidence gating and graceful fallback. Reliability over false precision.
  • Full Mobile Product: React Native (iOS + Android), Firebase, serverless backend, subscriptions, push, analytics, error monitoring, GDPR, and store submission.
  • Vendor Co-Development: Working directly with our vendors' engineering teams on capabilities that don't yet exist off the shelf.
